onboarding.title: A calmer way to read the cards
onboarding.intro: Explore Tarot and Zodiac at your own pace — no account or connection required.
onboarding.chooseBody: Open a Tarot reading or explore your Zodiac sign.
onboarding.drawBody: Hold your question in mind, then reveal one card or the full spread.
onboarding.readBody: Tap a revealed card for its meaning. Swipe through Yearly Tarot's five themes.
onboarding.tip: New here? Start with Card of the Day for one clear daily reflection.
onboarding.note: Readings are for reflection. Rewarded ads are always optional.

zodiacHome.subtitle: Choose your cosmic path
zodiacHome.originDescription: Discover the stories behind the 12 signs

settings.subtitle: Make this space your own
settings.languageDescription: Choose your interface language. Changes apply immediately and are saved on this device.
settings.translationDescription: Menus, 78 Tarot cards, 12 zodiac profiles and Day / Week / Year readings are translated for every language shown in this list. Text embedded in artwork remains in English. These readings are for reflection and entertainment.
settings.offline: Your language preference works offline. No account required.

adsQa.title: Advertising QA
adsQa.description: Load each ad format independently before testing its placement in the app.
adsQa.devOnly: This screen is available only when development mode is enabled.
adsQa.androidNote: The browser shows layout previews only. Install the debug APK to load native test ads.
adsQa.testNotice: Safe Google demo ad units are active. Only interact with ads marked Test Ad.
adsQa.bannerDescription: Tests the persistent bottom banner and reserved layout space.
adsQa.interstitialDescription: Loads and opens a full-screen test ad without navigation.
adsQa.rewardedDescription: Tests rewarded and skipped callbacks using a demo video.
adsQa.appOpenDescription: Tests the full-screen ad used after a returning-user cold start.
adsQa.nativeDescription: Loads native test assets into an in-app card.
